- No changes detected in this version.
- Skill functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous release.

Initial release of the Open Claude skill.

- Opens the Claude AI interface (Anthropic) in the Brave browser with a simple voice or typed command.
- Supports multiple trigger phrases such as "open claude," "launch claude," and more.
- Automatically detects your operating system (Windows, macOS, or Linux) and uses the correct command to launch Brave.
- Provides troubleshooting tips and requirements for smooth use.
